products.name: Grey Micro-Check Shirt with Flap Pocket

products.name: Women's Black Tailored Office Shirt

products.name: Summer Day Dress Duo
products.description: Two easy summer dresses in one bundle: a confetti-print tea dress and a grey tiered chiffon dress with a bow.
products.descriptionAr: فستانان صيفيان في عرض واحد: فستان مشجّر بألوان مبهجة وفستان شيفون رمادي بطبقات وفيونكة.

products.name: Black Mermaid Evening Gown
products.description: Strapless black mermaid gown with a sculpted bodice and a dramatic ruffled train for unforgettable evenings.

products.name: Blue Cotton Shirt with Patch Pocket
